readerCopy.body: A direct ask can cost less than another long period of resentment built around waiting for someone else to volunteer. When Mars sextiles Chiron, action and sensitivity cooperate, giving a manageable way to interrupt patterns of overaccommodation, hesitation, or defending everyone except the person with the need. A request, boundary, appointment, or small practical move can create a different outcome without becoming dramatic. The action matters because it gives vulnerability a concrete response.
